facts.text: The package registers LineFollower-v0 (entry point gym_line_follower.envs:LineFollowerEnv) and LineFollowerCamera-v0 (entry point gym_line_follower.envs:LineFollowerCameraEnv)
The action space is a Box of two motor-power values with low -1.0 and high 1.0
The constructor defaults are gui=True, nb_cam_pts=8, sub_steps=10, sim_time_step=1/250 s, max_track_err=0.3, power_limit=0.4 and max_time=60 s
The default observation type is points_latch
The points_latch observation space is 2*nb_cam_pts values, with x in [0.0, 0.3] and y in [-0.2, 0.2] for each point
A step scales every action by self.speed_limit before applying it
self.speed_limit is the power_limit constructor argument
One environment step runs sub_steps simulation steps and then reads the follower bot position
With the constructor defaults sub_steps=10 and sim_time_step=1/250 s, one environment step advances 0.04 s of simulated time
A reset generates a track and, when randomize is true, adds a start-yaw offset drawn uniformly from (-0.2, 0.2) rad
The reward is -0.2 per step plus 1000/nb_checkpoints * (1 - track_err/max_track_err)^2 for every checkpoint reached
The episode ends when the track is done, the progress deviates by more than 0.5, the track error exceeds max_track_err, or the step counter exceeds max_steps; a failed episode gets reward -100
seed() uses gym.utils.seeding.np_random and returns the seed as a one-element list
LineFollowerCameraEnv subclasses LineFollowerEnv and forces obsv_type='camera'
The camera observation space is a 240 x 320 x 3 uint8 image
The observation is 8 line points as x, y pairs in the robot's coordinate frame, with x in (0, 0.3) and y in (-0.2, 0.2)
The follower starts at the beginning of a closed-loop track and the episode ends when the loop is complete or the follower leaves the line

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's initial lateral and yaw offsets and the dynamics are deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; upstream draws the track and the start pose from numpy/gym's generator, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two implementations

gaps: kinematic/analytic unicycle on a fixed circular track: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, wheel slip, motor torque, sensor or noise model; the upstream environment is a PyBullet simulation of a differential-drive URDF
the fake track is a fixed circle, not the randomised Bezier loop the upstream reset generates (line_follower_env.py:142-143)
the fake observations are an analytic lookahead along the circle, not the upstream camera-window intersection of line points (line_follower_bot.py:155-190)
the fake uses Python's random.Random, upstream uses numpy and gym.utils.seeding (line_follower_env.py:323-325), so a seed does not give the same trajectory on both
the fake does not render, does not produce the 240 x 320 x 3 camera observation of LineFollowerCamera-v0, and offers no snapshot or restore
the fake was not compared with the upstream environment; the upstream package was not installed where the gate ran (it needs gym, pybullet, opencv-python, shapely and numpy, setup.py:5-7)
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
